$schema_note: Checked-in ratchet baseline for the import-hygiene CI gate (dev/import_hygiene_scan.py). Read by src/aeat/tests/test_import_hygiene_gate.py. Every entry below is a NAMED, documented exception -- never a bulk allowlist. A closing commit that fixes a violation MUST shrink the matching list in the SAME commit (aeat-architecture-boundaries relocation-atomicity discipline). See ADR 2026-07-01-import-centralization-adr Ruling 8.

production_family1_cross_package_private._note: Every production (non-test) cross-package private-import site the scanner currently finds. This is the CYCLE-BREAK exception set documented inline at each site (CYCLE-BREAK-RATIONALE-WORKFLOW-REVIEW): application.review and application.workflow import each other's private submodules directly to avoid re-entering a partially-initialised package during Python's import machinery. The gate FAILS if the current scan finds MORE sites than are listed here (regression); it does not fail if the count is lower, and Wave W06 flips this list to an empty list once the exception is structurally removed (hard-zero mode).

sites.reason: CYCLE-BREAK-RATIONALE-WORKFLOW-REVIEW: application.workflow imports application.review from inside its own _models module, so importing the application.workflow facade from application.review re-enters the partially-initialised workflow package and raises ImportError.

CYCLE-BREAK-RATIONALE-WORKFLOW-REVIEW: same cycle-break as the adjacent WorkflowEvent/WorkflowState import in this file; import the submodule directly to avoid triggering application.workflow.__init__ during the chain.

CYCLE-BREAK-RATIONALE-WORKFLOW-REVIEW: matching rationale to _actions.py; application.review._models is itself imported by application.workflow._models, so it cannot import the application.workflow facade without re-entering the partially-initialised package.
CYCLE-BREAK-RATIONALE-WORKFLOW-REVIEW: same cycle-break as the adjacent WorkflowEvent import in this file.

CYCLE-BREAK-RATIONALE-WORKFLOW-REVIEW: application.workflow._models imports application.review._models directly (not through the application.review facade) to avoid the same import-cycle re-entry in the opposite direction.

family2_shim_modules._note: Every module the scanner classifies as a Family-2 shim / pure-reexport surface. Each is a DOCUMENTED bridge (ADR Ruling 4): a single non-__init__ public re-export module is an acceptable canonical source when it carries a docstring explaining why. The gate fails if a NEW undocumented shim appears that is not in this list.

family3_pinned_duplicate_symbols._note: Named Family-3 'genuine duplicate' symbols the ADR investigated and pinned a disposition for (Ruling 5). The 7 umbrella app-layer re-exports (CalculationRevision, CalculationRevisionAmendmentKind, ExternalEvidenceKind, WorkUnit, link_transaction, suggest_reconciliations, verify_link_consistency) were RETIRED in Wave W03.P88 and must never reappear as multi-facade symbols. save_envelope and DEFAULT_IVA_GENERAL_RATE_PCT were investigated and require no action (two unrelated same-named functions; a benign zero-consumer duplicate declaration respectively) -- they are pinned here as the exact tolerated set so a NEW genuine cross-facade duplicate fails the gate.

tolerated_multi_sourced_symbols.reason: Two unrelated same-named functions (aeat.adapters.persistence.storage.envelope._envelope.save_envelope and aeat.core.observability._store.save_envelope). Investigated per the ADR; no consolidation needed. A cosmetic rename is deferred, out of scope.
